entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello? I need to make a return.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0125. I got a jersey last week and it's not working out for me.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF886-0125. I see the order for the Pro-Level Aero Jersey, delivered nine days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered my usual size, but this jersey is just the wrong size for me. It's way too tight across the chest. I'd like to process an exchange or just a return.

I see. Thank you for clarifying. It sounds like you need a different fit. Let me just check our policy... Okay, yes. Since you received it just nine days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for you.

That's good to hear. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of packaging it up and sending it back, and I'll probably just order the next size up anyway, could you offer a small discount code for my next purchase to make it worth the trouble?

I understand your position, but our policy allows for a full refund for the item itself, which I've already approved. I'm not able to add a promotional credit on top of that for a sizing issue. However, I can generate the pre-paid return label and email it to you right now so you can get your refund processed as quickly as possible.
Alright, that's fair enough. As long as the return is approved. Yes, please send over the label. My email is the one on the account.

Perfect. I've just sent that label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive the jersey, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
